questions.prompt: Explain the familiar social choice to someone who heard only the outcome. Include its reason and an important contrast.
questions.context:
Two students chose to help one another because one did not understand the lesson. Both said they wanted to help. After their attempt, that student still did not understand. Explain the reason for the choice and the contrasting result without turning failure into deliberate harm.
Familiar meanings available: deliberately; on purpose; each other; mutually; because; owing to; but; however.
questions.label: Take your speaking turn
